task: Fix assistant partial update so omitted optional None-default fields are preserved by correcting _should_update_field, migrating __fields_set__ to model_fields_set, and adding regression coverage for description and system_prompt.

key_reasoning.reason: Single domain-model component: Assistant._should_update_field and the fields_set read in _map_assistant_request (models/assistant.py). Router and repository are pass-throughs needing no change. A second helper path (_should_update_system_prompt) must also be covered, keeping this just above trivial.

Fix aligns with an already-proven convention (model_fields_set / exclude_unset used in assistant_service, mcp_config_service, models/index). Pure logic change, trivially reversible. Slight elevation because existing unit tests (TC-1.4, TC-1.5) encode the buggy contract and must be rewritten in lockstep, and a downstream AssistantVersionService.has_configuration_changes side effect must be verified.

One production file (~2 focused edits in models/assistant.py), 2-3 existing test edits (test_map_assistant_request_helpers.py, possibly test_map_assistant_request_metadata.py), plus 1-2 new regression tests, spanning src/.../models and tests/.../models.
